title: Min-Marginal Power Indices for Multi-Objective Feature Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.33885v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Game-theoretic feature selection scores each feature by its average marginal contribution across coalitions. An average shows whether a feature helps overall, but not whether, in some coalition, adding it turns an acceptable model into an unacceptable one. Building on minimum marginal aggregation, we define the Min-Marginal Power Index (MinPI) on a binary utility-threshold game. For a fixed quota, MinPI takes the value -1, 0, or +1 and labels each feature harmful, neutral, or decisive. A harmful label carries its own evidence, an evaluated coalition in which adding the feature drops utility below the quota, so no score cutoff is needed; finite-budget estimators keep this property but may miss harmful features. We use MinPI to propose feature removals, which are accepted only if they pass a validation gate, and to prefilter multi-objective search. translated_title: 面向多目标特征选择的最小边际权力指数
translated_abstract: 博弈论特征选择通过特征在各联盟中的平均边际贡献为其打分。平均值只能反映一个特征总体上是否有帮助，却无法反映在某些联盟中，加入该特征是否会使一个原本可接受的模型变得不可接受。基于最小边际聚合，我们在二元效用阈值博弈上定义了最小边际权力指数。在固定配额下，MinPI 的取值为 -1、0 或 +1，并将每个特征标记为有害、中性或决定性。有害标签自带证据，即在某个被评估的联盟中，加入该特征会使效用降至配额以下，因此无需设置分数截断阈值；有限预算的估计器保留这一性质，但可能遗漏有害特征。我们利用 MinPI 提出特征移除建议，只有通过验证门槛的建议才会被接受，并将其用于多目标搜索的预筛选。在六个基准数据集、五个随机种子上的实验中，MinPI 移除了 12.5% 的被分析特征，几乎……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文在二元效用阈值博弈上提出了最小边际权力指数（MinPI），能将特征标记为有害、中性或决定性且有害标签自带证据，无需分数截断即可有效指导多目标特征选择中的特征移除与搜索预筛选。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Min-Marginal Power Index (MinPI) on a binary utility-threshold game, which labels features as harmful, neutral, or decisive with self-contained evidence for harmful labels, eliminating the need for score cutoffs when guiding feature removal and prefiltering multi-objective search.
